posts.title: Ong’s Hat: Compleat
posts.description: Ong's Hat: COMPLEAT by Joseph Matheny (with Sequoyah Kennedy and an introduction by David Metcalfe) is a comprehensive, multi-media archival and conversational project that documents the history and deep lore of Ong’s Hat—one of the earliest and most influential alternate reality games (ARGs) and transmedia storytelling experiments of the late 20th century.

posts.title: The Liminal Cycle (A Trilogy) by Joseph Matheny
posts.description: The Liminal Cycle is a multi-media narrative trilogy and experimental project created by American writer and transmedia artist Joseph Matheny, known for pioneering alternate reality games (ARGs) like Ong's Hat.
